tweet.text:
the other day I looked at city level data for a "boring" business idea, and I couldn't believe my eyes.

I've become a little obsessed at finding these arbitrage plays.

3/4 of the businesses in the niche didn't even have a website and the providers aren't even replying to google reviews

you're playing on hard mode if you're trying to sell AI to AI people

$1,000+ average ticket size with around 4,000 searches a month for the money keyword and you could outrank the competitors in a couple weeks

you just need to be 10%+ better than the competitors in digital presence, marketing, ops, customer service: THIS IS WHERE YOU USE AI (btw you can be 2x/3x better)

yesterday was a good day in "boring" business land, sharing the receipts b/c few have them and I do this every day as a real practitioner and business owner

more on this soon
